status: Class-aware heuristic for controlled experiments; not an optimal-build claim

apis.refund: game.resetMastery(state, heroUid): free full refund, no wallet or level edits
apis.available: game.masteryState(state, heroUid).nodes: choose canLearn and on !== false
apis.learn: game.learnMastery(state, heroUid, node.id), repeat while a permitted candidate exists

orderingNotes: Apply exact classFirstIds in order before generic stat ordering; each node can be filled to its legitimate maximum.
Only use the caster exclusions when the currently equipped weapon has basic_attack=false; equipping an off-class weapon can change this mode.
Favor n.cond absent or '-' before conditional nodes within the same priority; on=false denotes a currently inactive equipment gate.
For generic same-stat ties, prefer class tree over sin tree, then stable data order.
Knight ordering assumes the knight is the exposed front tank. Do not label this universally optimal for rear-row or offensive knight builds.
Priest buff duration is useful for actual buff skills, not for direct healing. Put it after CDR/casting speed/magic attack unless the experiment explicitly tests a buff build.
All this changes is legitimate point allocation. Keep each test branch's wallet, equipment, XP, drop seed, battle counter and elapsed time unchanged until actual attempts run.
The cohort adaptive bundle may also retreat-farm after repeated failures; root ablations must separate that effect from respec.
